population_definition: all kernels in shard FV-PROPFLOOR-SHARD-B18-1, enumerated below by kernel id and spec digest
scope_correction: The WU row named 10 kernels (art-89, art-90, art-94, art-97, art-98, art-235, art-237, art-238, art-239, art-241). Direct inspection during authoring found that 5 of the 10 (art-235-test-hpml-escrow, art-237-validate-agent-audit-trail, art-238-classify-annex3-decisioning-obligations, art-239-test-bifsg-bias-thresholds, art-241-cbpr-structured-address-linter) were already floored by FV-PROPFLOOR-SHARD-B8-1 (commit ec54d31f, PR #1112) — the row's own cutplan source (research/FV-PHASE2-CUTPLAN-WAVE5-2026-08-10.md) double-counted them. This shard's proptest files for those 5 kernels were drafted, ran green against their own fixtures, then reverted (`git checkout HEAD --`) rather than overwriting the already-landed B8-1 files, per Standing Order #0 (no drift/deletion of existing work). This manifest and shard therefore floor only the 5 kernels genuinely new to this population: art-89, art-90, art-94, art-97, art-98. The ORCH should adjust the wave's remaining count / next cutplan batch to account for the 5-kernel overlap found here.
independence_sentence: Each item listed was reviewed and attested independently; the single signature is a mechanical convenience over the enumerated digests, not a bulk review.
per_item_basis_of_review: Every row ran the same two mechanical checks unconditionally: (1) the fixture-oracle gate — compute() output diffed via JSON.stringify against the kernel's own existing golden fixtures before any property was trusted, and (2) run-proptests.mjs green (process exit 0, confirmed as part of the full 313/313 suite run for this shard, which includes these 5 new files plus all pre-existing floor files unchanged). ULP-boundary forcing was mandatory and present for the 1 float-sensitive row named in the WU that is genuinely new to this population (art-90-sanctions-screening-fit-diagnostic). The other 4 rows are the row's stated float:no exceptions and instead carry forced CATEGORICAL boundary cases (ML-DSA short-circuit, keyword decision-tree matches, enum-boundary strings, empty/malformed-object inputs) in place of ULP forcing. art-90 needed a documented shape correction after direct measurement against the kernel: its arithmetic has zero continuous user-supplied numeric input (every score derives from categorical enum/array selections through fixed integer weights), so its ULP-forcing was applied as forced exact-integer grade-threshold cases (raw_total = 85/82) plus forced half-integer Math.round rounding cases (12.5->13, 18.75->19, 6.25->6) — the discrete-domain analogue of the spec's literal denormal/negative-zero cases, which do not apply to a kernel with no continuous float input; this is stated explicitly in that file's own header comment. No row beyond these mechanical checks received a separate in-depth human review in this pass — that is exactly the gap human_sign_off.status=PENDING names.

items.ulp_forcing_note: stated float:no exception per the WU row — exposed_pubkey_pct/address_reuse_pct are compared with plain >=/> against fixed integer thresholds, no arithmetic performed; forced CATEGORICAL boundary cases used instead (ML-DSA short-circuit, exact tier-threshold integers 25/24/10/9/30/31, empty policy_parameters)

kernel has zero continuous float user input — every score derives from categorical/array selections through fixed integer weights. ULP-forcing applied as forced exact-integer grade-threshold cases (raw_total=85/82) and forced half-integer Math.round boundary cases (covered=1/2/3 => 6.25->6, 12.5->13, 18.75->19), the discrete-domain analogue of threshold-ULP/denormal forcing for a kernel with no continuous float surface. See file header for full rationale.
